## In-Country Missions

Technical assistance missions were undertaken in response to CPC requests and priorities identified through the review of national submissions and recommendations from IOTC bodies. The missions combined technical discussions, assessment of national systems and practical support for data reporting, with follow-up activities identified jointly with national counterparts.

**Tanzania.** The mission reviewed plans to reconstruct historical catches from coastal fisheries, progress in harmonising fisheries data management across institutions and reporting requirements for industrial fisheries. Discussions identified opportunities to consolidate historical datasets, refine estimation procedures and strengthen statistical and ROS reporting.

**Kenya.** The mission provided technical support and hands-on training to Kenya Fisheries Service officers on IOTC reporting requirements and tools, including e-MARIS and the ROS. Discussions reviewed existing datasets, progress towards an integrated national data management system and opportunities to improve data collection and historical catch estimates.

**Comoros.** The mission assessed fisheries data collection, storage and processing arrangements, including follow-up on systems developed under an earlier project. It identified opportunities to strengthen data management and considered the potential for Comoros to contribute to a coastal fisheries data-processing pilot under EC1350.

**Madagascar.** The mission reviewed fisheries data collection and management systems through discussions with national authorities and stakeholders and visits to landing sites. Priority areas for cooperation included national sampling strategies, harmonised data collection procedures, electronic data management and capacity development (Appendix IV).

**Oman.** The mission reviewed fisheries data collection, processing and reporting through discussions with the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources and visits to landing sites and the Central Fish Market. Practical guidance on IOTC reporting was provided, with follow-up priorities covering catch estimation, species identification and integrated data management (Appendix V).

## Virtual Technical Meetings

The Data Section also maintained technical exchanges with CPCs to clarify reporting requirements, review submissions and follow up on ongoing data improvement activities (**[Appendix I](#AppDataSectionActivities)**).
